_comment: Every prompt `npdev ai relay` composes (npdev_relay_prompts.py). string.Template syntax ($name / ${name}); braces are literal, so JSON examples need no escaping. Prompts are ENGLISH on purpose (the knowledge bundle is English and was measured that way); the user's language enters through the 'language' block. Changing a template changes what the bench measures: re-run the relay bench arm (scripts/ai/bench, arm relay) after any edit. Placeholders: code (4 chars), round, language, knowledge, ask, model, outline, errors, trail, files_expected, budget. `sizeLimit` and `smaller` are used ONLY when an answer size was asked for or after a repeated cut-off; every other prompt stays byte-identical to the measured ones (test_relay_prompts pins their hashes).
header:
NPDEV-PROMPT $code-$round
(The line above and the matching NPDEV-PROMPT-END line below are for the NPDev app on my computer. Never repeat any line that starts with NPDEV-PROMPT.)
formatContract:
You are authoring an application for NPDev, a model-driven app platform: a JSON model is validated, then a real web application is generated from it. I will copy your answer back into NPDev, which reads it automatically, so the FORMAT below is mandatory.

Reply in EXACTLY this shape:

NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round
(one or two sentences about what you did)
NPDEV-FILE model.json
```json
(the COMPLETE model.json)
```
NPDEV-FILE npdev-submission.json
```json
{ "request": "(my request in one line)", "renames": [], "deliberateRemovals": [], "securityChanges": [], "couldNotExpress": [], "assumptions": [] }
```
NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected

Rules for the answer:
- Write every file INSIDE this message, each in its own ```json block, right after its NPDEV-FILE line. Do not use canvas, artifacts, attachments, downloads or code-execution tools.
- Always the COMPLETE file. Never write "...", "// rest unchanged", "(same as before)" or any placeholder: NPDev rejects an answer with parts left out.
- Plain JSON only: no comments, no trailing commas.
- npdev-submission.json: in "renames" every rename, as {"kind": "field", "concept": "Customer", "from": "phone", "to": "mobile"} or {"kind": "concept", "from": "Client", "to": "Customer"} (and the renamed object must carry "renamedFrom"); in "deliberateRemovals" everything you removed on purpose, as {"kind": "field", "concept": "Customer", "name": "fax"} or {"kind": "concept", "name": "OldThing"}; in "securityChanges" one plain sentence per change to who can see or do what; in "couldNotExpress" one plain sentence per thing I asked that the model cannot express; in "assumptions" one plain sentence per assumption. Empty lists are fine and must still be present.
- If your answer would be too long for one message, say so in one sentence instead of cutting it.
language: Language: write your one-or-two-sentence explanation in $language. Write every user-visible label of the app (ui.label, enum display labels, page and menu titles) in $language. Keep identifiers (concept, field, flow and page names) in plain ASCII PascalCase/camelCase, without accents or spaces.

interview.off: Do not ask me questions. Make reasonable assumptions and list them in "assumptions".
interview.on: Before writing any file, ask me the questions you need (at most 8, numbered, in $language) and wait for my answers. Only then reply in the format above.

intent.create:
Task: create a NEW application.

What I want:
$ask
intent.change:
Task: CHANGE an existing application. Below is its current model.json. Return the COMPLETE updated model.json with my change applied, and leave every concept, field, flow and page I did not mention exactly as it is. If the change RENAMES a field or concept, keep the data by declaring "renamedFrom": "<old name>" on the renamed object (never delete-and-add). Never remove anything I did not ask to remove.

Current model.json:
```json
$model
```

What I want changed:
$ask
intent.fix:
Task: the application below FAILED. Fix the cause in the model and return the COMPLETE corrected model.json.

Current model.json:
```json
$model
```

What failed (from NPDev, secrets and personal paths removed):
$errors
intent.pack:
Task: write a reusable NPDev PACK (a part other apps import), not an application. Return pack.json (and npdev-submission.json).

$ask

Current pack.json, when this is a new version of an existing pack (empty for a new pack):
```json
$model
```

pack._comment: Intent pack (P4): a browser AI writes a reusable pack. formatContract replaces the app one; rules follow the shared authoring knowledge. The answer is 2 files (pack.json + npdev-submission.json), example-model.json optional.
pack.formatContract:
You are authoring a reusable PACK for NPDev, a model-driven app platform. A pack is a named, versioned set of definitions (records, queries, roles ...) that many applications import; it is NOT an application. I will copy your answer back into NPDev, which reads it automatically, so the FORMAT below is mandatory.

Reply in EXACTLY this shape:

NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round
(one or two sentences about what the pack holds)
NPDEV-FILE pack.json
```json
(the COMPLETE pack.json)
```
NPDEV-FILE npdev-submission.json
```json
{ "request": "(my request in one line)", "packId": "(the pack id)", "packVersion": "(the version you wrote)", "renames": [], "deliberateRemovals": [], "securityChanges": [], "couldNotExpress": [], "assumptions": [] }
```
NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected

Optionally, between those two files, an NPDEV-FILE example-model.json (a tiny application model that imports the pack, to show it composes).

Rules for the answer:
- Write every file INSIDE this message, each in its own ```json block, right after its NPDEV-FILE line. Do not use canvas, artifacts, attachments, downloads or code-execution tools.
- Always the COMPLETE file. Never write "...", "// rest unchanged", "(same as before)" or any placeholder: NPDev rejects an answer with parts left out.
- Plain JSON only: no comments, no trailing commas.
- npdev-submission.json: "renames" and "deliberateRemovals" list every concept or field you renamed or removed on purpose (same shapes as for an application); "securityChanges" one plain sentence per change to who may read or write; "couldNotExpress" what you could not model; "assumptions" what you assumed.
pack.rules:
Rules for a PACK (in addition to the authoring knowledge above; the concepts, fields, queries and access expressions follow the same contract):
- pack.json "pack" is EXACTLY the pack id given above. Write "dslVersion", "pack", "version" (semantic version), "namespace", "description" (one plain sentence of what it is for) and "category".
- A NEW pack is version 1.0.0. For a NEW VERSION of the current pack shown above, keep everything the request does not mention exactly as it is and raise the version: patch for a fix, minor for something ADDED, major for anything removed, renamed or made stricter. Never lower it.
- Put in the pack only what any application needs to reuse it: concepts, queries, roles, procedures, panels, events, domain types and the like. Refer only to concepts this pack declares itself; do not refer to anything of one particular app. Names are plain PascalCase / camelCase and are NOT prefixed with the pack id (NPDev qualifies them).
- Custom capabilities: write the CONTRACT only (name, inputs, outputs, what it means). No code, no "bindings" to an adapter or a service of one app: the consuming app supplies those.
- Never write "signature", "migrations", "firstPublishedVersion" or "forkedFrom": NPDev fills them. No keys, passwords, tokens, personal data or addresses of real people anywhere.
- Say who may read and write each concept in "access", the way the knowledge above shows: a reusable part must not leave its records open to everyone.
- example-model.json, when you write it, is a minimal application model that imports the pack with {"$$ref": "packs/<pack id>/pack.json", "as": "<short alias>"}. It is only a proof; NPDev does not keep it.

attachmentMessage: Please follow the instructions in the attached file, and answer in exactly the format it describes.
knowledgeHeading:
=== NPDev authoring knowledge (contract, allowed values, verified examples) ===
$knowledge
=== end of NPDev authoring knowledge ===

sameChat._comment: Short follow-ups for the SAME chat (the AI already has the knowledge and the conversation). Key = the outcome that triggers it.
sameChat.NEEDS_FIX:
NPDev checked your model and found these problems:
$errors

Fix every one and send the COMPLETE corrected files again, in the same format, starting with NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round and ending with NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected.
sameChat.TRUNCATED: Your last answer was cut off before the end, so NPDev could not use it. Send it again COMPLETE, in the same format (NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round ... NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected). If it does not fit in one message, tell me in one sentence instead.
sameChat.ELIDED: Your last answer left parts out (for example "..." or "rest unchanged"). NPDev needs every file COMPLETE. Send the complete files again in the same format, starting with NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round and ending with NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected.
sameChat.BAD_JSON:
NPDev could not read the JSON in your last answer:
$errors

Send the files again as plain valid JSON (double quotes, no comments, no trailing commas), in the same format: NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round ... NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected.
sameChat.PARTIAL:
Part of your last answer could not be used:
$errors

Send model.json and npdev-submission.json again, complete, in the same format (NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round ... NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected). Do not send other files.
sameChat.FILE_LINK_ONLY: I cannot open files or links from here. Please write the files directly inside your message instead, in the format I gave you: NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round ... NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected.
sameChat.NO_FILES: Please answer with the files, in the format I gave you: NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round, then each NPDEV-FILE line followed by its ```json block, then NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected.

freshChat:
Earlier attempts failed; do not reintroduce these errors:
$trail

The current model.json FAILED with these problems:
$errors

Current model.json:
```json
$model
```

Original request:
$ask
sizeLimit: Size limit: this chat cuts answers that are too long, so model.json must stay under about $budget characters (the whole file, counting every space). If the app needs more than that, write only its CORE now -- the main concepts with their fields, lifecycles and roles -- and say in your one or two sentences what you left for later; I will ask for the rest in the next step. Never cut a file in the middle.
smaller: Your last answer was cut off again. Send a SMALLER version this time: model.json under about $budget characters (the whole file, counting every space). Write only the CORE of the app -- the main concepts with their fields, lifecycles and roles -- and say in one sentence what you left for later. Same format as before (NPDEV-BEGIN $code-$round ... NPDEV-END $code-$round files=$files_expected).
